original.statement: The metric cilium_triggers_policy_update_folds has been removed in Cilium 1.17.

corrected.statement: The Cilium metric cilium_triggers_policy_update_folds has been removed in 1.17 (listed under Removed Metrics in the upgrade notes).

decision.reason: [ev-070e2e78535d] lists `cilium_triggers_policy_update_folds` under "Removed Metrics" and says it has been removed, so the change type "removed" is right. No subject family covers metrics. protocol-behavior is the closest runtime-only family, but its names are free-form and must be lowercase kebab-case, so the underscore spelling is wrong. The name is corrected to "cilium-triggers-policy-update-folds", built only from the evidence's own words. Confidence is low because no family clearly fits a metric.
